questions.text:
Consider the following array of elements.
(89,19,50,17,12,15,2,5,7,11,6,9,100)
The minimum number of interchanges needed to convert it into a max-heap is
questions.solution:
Only 100 (at the last position) breaks the heap property. It sifts up:

- swap with parent 15
- swap with parent 50
- swap with root 89

Everything else already satisfies the max-heap rule, so 3 interchanges.

Answer: 3

questions.text: While inserting the elements 71, 65, 84, 69, 67, 83 in an empty binary search tree (BST) in the sequence shown, the element in the lowest level is
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- 71 root; 65 left, 84 right
- 69: right of 65; 67: left of 69 (level 3)
- 83: left of 84 (level 2)

The deepest element is 67.

Answer: 67
